test_cases.name: SDK Fallback List BMS
test_cases.command: python3 -c "import os; from huaweicloudsdkcore.auth.credentials import BasicCredentials; from huaweicloudsdkbms.v1.region.bms_region import BmsRegion; from huaweicloudsdkbms.v1 import BmsClient, ListBareMetalServersRequest; c=BmsClient.new_builder().with_credentials(BasicCredentials(os.getenv('HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_AK'),os.getenv('HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_SK'))).with_region(BmsRegion.value_of('cn-north-4')).build(); r=c.list_bare_metal_servers(ListBareMetalServersRequest(limit=25)); print('SDK OK, servers:', [s.name for s in (r.servers or [])])"
test_cases.expected: SDK returns the same server list
